title: Whiteboard: The line after the plan: a ticket from intake to main
about: One board draws the whole line, so the person reads every state and move in one place.

understood.label: You asked
understood.text: Draw the state machine on a whiteboard I can read.

sections.heading: The line, drawn
sections.body: Each shape is one state; each line is a move between two of them.

board.title: The line after the plan: a ticket from intake to main

shapes.label: 0 intake
shapes.note: Beads: status open; type; priority; parent; born-from. Owner: The lead of the home.

shapes.label: 1 held for owner
shapes.note: Beads: status on_hold or deferred, with the reason. Owner: The owner.

shapes.label: 2 approved
shapes.note: Beads: open, no open dependency; the approval record; brief and route. Owner: The lead, or the dispatch check.

shapes.label: 3 coding
shapes.note: Beads: in_progress; assignee; a live lease; lane=working. Owner: The worker.

shapes.label: 3a waiting
shapes.note: Beads: lane=blocked, needs-decision, paused or capacity-wait; a dependency when it waits for a ticket; a child decision ticket when it asks. Owner: The worker;…

shapes.label: 3b parked
shapes.note: Beads: on_hold; station=parked. Owner: The lead who parked it.

shapes.label: 4 ready
shapes.note: Beads: lane=done; station=ready. Owner: The worker until the proof is whole; then the landing check.

shapes.label: 5 landing
shapes.note: Beads: station=landing. Owner: The landing check.

shapes.label: 5a refused
shapes.note: Beads: station=refused with the reason. Owner: The worker for a red or a conflict; the tick for a wait.

shapes.label: 6 landed
shapes.note: Beads: station=landed. Owner: No one: the belt splits here.

shapes.label: 7 cleaned
shapes.note: Beads: status closed; station=cleaned. Owner: The sweep.

shapes.label: 8 live
shapes.note: Beads: station=live. Owner: The go-live tick.

shapes.label: 9 release open
shapes.note: Beads: station=release-open; the pull request address. Owner: The release tick, or the lead until D1.

shapes.label: 10 release green
shapes.note: Beads: station=release-ci-running, then release-green or release-red. Owner: The forge; the feeder.

shapes.label: 10 release red
shapes.note: Beads: station=release-ci-running, then release-green or release-red. Owner: The forge; the feeder.

shapes.label: 11 merged into main
shapes.note: Beads: station=merged. Owner: The merge check, on his standing word.

shapes.label: 12 next trunk
shapes.note: Beads: station=rolled. Owner: The merge pass, with the landing check as backstop.

arrows.label: needs owner
arrows.note: Today: Yes. Starts: A question only the owner can answer

arrows.label: his answer
arrows.note: Today: Yes; the main chat by slice 38. Starts: His answer: a card, a phone note, or an order typed in the main chat

arrows.label: lead approves
arrows.note: Today: Slices 15, 40. Starts: The lead approves; or a plan's follow-up stated ahead files it

arrows.note: Today: Yes. Starts: The worker's done line passes the proof guard

arrows.note: Today: The forge yes; the feeder by slice 31. Starts: CI ends

steps.title: The line after the plan
steps.text: This is the line as the jg-7v6uw plan leaves it, not as it runs today. A solid arrow runs by itself today. A dashed arrow is done by hand today or is not built yet. The ticket id rides the belt from intake to landed.

steps.title: The owner stands at one post
steps.text: A ticket is held only for a question he alone can answer. His answer moves it to approved. A lead can approve without him.

steps.title: Coding, waiting and parked
steps.text: A free lane starts the work. A wait clears by itself or by a decision. A lead can park a lane. If the worker dies, its lease expires and the ticket goes back to approved.

steps.title: A landing lands or is refused
steps.text: The done line makes the ticket ready. A whole proof starts the landing. A red or a conflict sends it back to coding.

steps.title: After landed the belt splits
steps.text: One branch cleans up and closes the ticket. The other takes the change to the homes. Side exits close a ticket from any post: dropped, archived, superseded, reverted.

steps.title: The release: to main, then the next trunk
steps.text: When the trunk holds enough, a release opens. Red returns after a fix. Green merges on his standing word, and the next trunk version starts.
